title: Daniel Thomas pleads not guilty after alleged dinghy slashing in Channel
summary_full: Far-right activist who was filmed appearing to slash boat with blade is refused bail as he denies chargesThe far-right agitator Daniel Thomas has pleaded not guilty to causing criminal damage after he was filmed apparently slashing a boat in the Channel with a blade while an emergency responder was onboard.Thomas, 37, appeared at Basingstoke magistrates court on Friday morning. He also pleaded not guilty to failing to disclose to police the pin number of his phone, under section 53 of the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000. Continue reading...
